ignoreValues.reason: Deliberate and load-bearing: the coloured glows ARE the phase-signalling system on this dark surface (downloading / converting / done / error). Each now matches the colour of the element it lights; the previous mismatches (an amber dot glowing violet) were the real bug and are fixed.

Progress bars transition on width. transform:scaleX would stretch the gradient fill and detach the 1:1 reference tick in the size tracker. The bars are 6-8px tall, so the layout cost is negligible and the honest property is the right one.

Both elements are populated by JS after a fetch and are display:none until then. src="" was the genuine defect (it resolves to the page URL and paints a broken-image glyph) and is fixed; omitting the attribute is the correct empty state.
11px is this tool's agreed floor for monospace instrumentation labels, raised from 9-10px in this pass. Body copy is 15px.
0.14em is applied only to short uppercase monospace labels, which the rule text itself permits. Body copy tracks at 0.

The only match is the indeterminate progress bar, where a looping animation is the message (working, duration unknown) rather than decoration. Under prefers-reduced-motion it becomes an opacity breathe so the signal survives without travel.
Outline buttons pair a 1px border with a hover elevation shadow. The shadow exists only on hover and only for fine pointers, so the two never read as a single resting treatment.
Label-then-explanation is the consistent, deliberate pattern for this tool's checkbox and preset descriptions, not prose cadence.
